text:
Carlos (AE): Hey team, stuck on AcmeCorp POC — dedicated GPU pool provisioning failing with AZ affinity error in eu-west1, customer is waiting and they also sent price vs committed questions + security questionnaire. Can someone triage?
Jonas (SE): On it. Can you paste the provisioning error or job id? Any reservation config they requested (single-AZ affinity vs multi-AZ)? :thinking:
Carlos (AE): job: prow-6221. They asked for "zone affinity: prefer eu-west1-b" and reservation_count=8. I kicked the request twice, same failure.
Priya (Infra): Looking at scheduler logs now. infra-bot shows the job failed during allocation. Pasting the most relevant snippet:```
ERROR [allocator] ReservationAllocationFailed: AZ_ALLOCATION_CONFLICT
 details: requested_zones=[eu-west1-b], available_pools={eu-west1-b:0, eu-west1-c:6, eu-west1-d:4}
 suggestion: fallback_to_multi_zone or reduce_zone_strictness
```
Carlos (AE): so eu-west1-b is out of capacity? customer specifically wants b for data residency in that AZ — can we explain?
Jonas (SE): short answer: capacity in b exhausted for committed pool size. Longer: underlying cloud has limited spare GPUs in b for that quota window. Two options: 1) Offer multi-AZ reservation with placement preference for b (best-effort), 2) Move to eu-west2 (closest region) and maintain single-AZ affinity there.
Maya (Account): AcmeCorp asked about price delta if we split across AZs vs single-AZ reserved. They want committed pricing for 8 GPUs. Is there any surcharge for multi-AZ?
Jonas (SE): No surcharge for multi-AZ in our pricing model — committed capacity price is per-GPU-month. But operational note: multi-AZ can slightly increase latency variance and reduce absolute chance of a single-AZ outage. We can offer a 30-day rollback window if they want safety.
Priya (Infra): quick note on rollouts: if we change reservation config we'll need to reprovision which takes ~15-25min once capacity found. If they accept preferred-affinity (soft), allocator will place where available and tag resources with affinity_hint=b. Works in ~5-10min.
Carlos (AE): they also attached a security questionnaire asking about private VPC, KMS, and audit logs — SEs, can you confirm these are supported in Dedicated?
Jonas (SE): Yes — Dedicated supports VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and audit logs retention options. I'll draft responses and attach infra links.
Maya (Account): Can we give the customer a recommended config to unblock POC quickly? Prefer minimal change.
Jonas (SE): Recommend: set zone_affinity to ["eu-west1-b"] as preference (not hard requirement), reservation_count=8, and enable failover_zone=["eu-west1-c"] in case b lacks capacity. Provide them price quote for committed 8 GPUs at committed rate and note per-GPU on-demand as fallback.
Priya (Infra): I'll try a pref-affinity reprovision now against leftover pools. infra-bot: start_reprovision prow-6221 --affinity=soft --failover=eu-west1-c
infra-bot: Reprovision job queued, attempt=1
Jonas (SE): I'll prepare the short email blurb explaining the tradeoffs + the security checklist answers. Carlos, can you ask AcmeCorp to sign off on soft-affinity so we can proceed?
Carlos (AE): pinged them. They replied: "We prefer b but ok with automatic failover to c for now. Need a written note about expected latency variance and the security answers."
Maya (Account): Great. Once infra confirms reprovision success, I'll update the PO and pricing. Everyone ok with the approach? :thumbsup:
Priya (Infra): reprovision succeeded — infra-bot shows allocation_id=alloc-5543 placed 6 in c and 2 in b (preference honored where possible).
infra-bot: AllocationComplete alloc-5543 status=PARTIAL_PREFERRED (2@eu-west1-b,6@eu-west1-c)
Jonas (SE): I'll draft the latency note: expect 5-20ms additional variance for cross-AZ traffic inside eu-west1, no impact to model correctness. Sending draft in thread.
Carlos (AE): Customer approved the soft-affinity + wants the committed quote. Also requested engineers access to audit logs for first 48h — can we provide temporary access?
Jonas (SE): Yes, we can grant read-only audit logs for their principal for 48h via a signed grant. I'll coordinate with Security.
Maya (Account): I'll attach the pricing PDF and security answers to the SOW once Jonas confirms. Thanks team, great triage. :rocket:
